meta.note: Lowest Defence level a monster can be drained to, by Wiki monster name (any version). "base" = can't be drained. Others can be drained to 0. Araxxor: 'His Defence level can be only drained by up to 45 levels' (Araxxor/Strategies). The Fractured Archive's bosses stop at 60% of their base (The Fractured Archive/Strategies). The Fractured Archive (from its strategy page): Archive Guardian 260->156, Ezekiel 200->120, Bork 300->180, Moia 195->117, Xarth 170->102, Ocellus P1 215->129, P3 250->150; Dreadnoth, the Dagon'hai and Ocellus P2 (The Blade) can be drained to 0.
meta.source: OSRS Wiki strategy pages and boss pages
